title: 1.1 AI Era Innovation Matrix
problem: AI system scaling from edge to cloud demands rapid innovation across silicon, packaging, architecture, and software in response to unprecedented AI growth.
motivation: Lightning-fast AI progression requires system-level advancements spanning chip design, package technology, and network interconnection to support low-power edge devices through datacenter-scale cloud infrastructure.
method: Position paper presenting a matrix of enabling technologies across silicon (chip design, process), packaging (chiplet integration, thermal), architecture (system-level optimization), and software/networking to empower AI system scaling.
key_novelty: Holistic framing of AI-era technology innovation spanning all system levels from silicon to software.
contributions: Technology matrix addressing AI scaling across system hierarchy
Identification of innovation frontiers in chip, packaging, and architecture design
System-level perspective on enabling large-scale AI deployment
primary_theme: technology matrix for AI-era system scaling
